name: ZBL-08 (Type 08 family)
protection: Welded steel hull with bolt-on armour; amphibious. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; frontal arc resists 12.7/14.5 mm; 7.62x54R damages optics, tyres/tracks and exposed gear, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear; all launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Large 8x8 hull with four evenly spaced axles and a sloped nose with trim vane
Small two-man turret with 30 mm cannon set mid-hull
Rear ramp, side vision blocks and stowage boxes along the hull
Family base for ZTL-11 105 mm assault gun, PLL-09 122 mm SPH and command variants
